t: An independent Muslim kingdom that united the Bengal delta in 1352 and ruled it from Pandua and Gaur until 1576.
Rice, sugar, muslin and silk made it rich, and its ports of Chittagong and Satgaon traded from the Red Sea to China.
Its sultans patronised Bengali literature and built distinctive brick and terracotta mosques.
dyk: In 1414 envoys from Bengal presented a giraffe from East Africa to the Yongle Emperor in China, where it was hailed as a qilin, a mythical creature of good omen.
ev: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah unites Bengal as an independent sultanate
Firuz Shah Tughluq's invasion from Delhi ends in withdrawal
The Adina Mosque at Pandua is completed
A Bengali embassy presents a giraffe to the Yongle Emperor
Alauddin Husain Shah becomes sultan, ending the Habshi period
Daud Khan Karrani is defeated at Rajmahal and Bengal passes to the Mughals

f.capital: Pandua; later Gaur; Tanda under the Karranis
